snippet.title: Rusalka Wrath - Story-Driven Noir Action Trailer
snippet.description:
Infiltrate the Russian mafia as an undercover agent in early 2000s New York. A brutal 2D cinematic shooter set in a living, interactive underworld. Navigate through gritty billiard halls and smoky gambling dens, using lethal slow-motion combat to complete your mission and bring the mafia down.

**Wishlist on Steam:**  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3166040/Rusalka_Wrath/
